summary: Frontend-only testing of NEW per-equipment maintenance parameters feature across 5 scenarios (EquipmentMaster form, MaintenanceScan, AreaScan, PreProductionScan, EquipmentScan). All 5 scenarios PASS end-to-end using CEO admin_bypass. Backend Mongo record verified with parameters[] and parameters_out_of_range populated.

test_results.T1_equipment_master_params: PASS — Edited ZZ ParamEq Scan; eq-params-block visible; eq-param-name-0='Pressure', unit-0='bar', min-0='2', max-0='6'; eq-param-name-1='Temperature', unit-1='°C', max-1='40'. eq-param-add appends a new row (2→3); eq-param-remove-<i> deletes it (3→2).
test_results.T2_maintenance_scan_readings: PASS — /maintenance-scan/<token>: scan-params block shown ABOVE remarks with Pressure (bar) * and Temperature (°C) inputs plus '2 – 6' / '– – 40' limit hints. Selecting 'Maintenance Complete' + submitting with empty Pressure produced toast 'Enter the required parameter(s): Pressure' (from server). Setting Pressure=7.5 → input gains rose border AND 'Out of range' hint. Second submit → success (Log Another card visible). Mongo maintenance_records shows parameters[] = [Pressure=7.5 in_range:false, Temperature=null in_range:null] and parameters_out_of_range = ['Pressure = 7.5 bar (allowed 2.0–6.0)']; status='completed'.
test_results.T3_area_scan_dialog: PASS — /area-scan/<areaId>: clicking area-eq-check-<E_AREA> opens param-capture-dialog. capture-submit disabled initially; entering capture-pressure=4 enables it; clicking Save → row shows 'Done · Saved ✓ by System Admin · untick to undo'.
test_results.T4_pre_production_scan: PASS — /pre-production-scan/nyla-air-water: ticking pre-production-check-<E_PRE> opens dialog; submit disabled until Pressure entered; after save shows 'Cleared · By System Admin'. Unticking returns row to 'Pending'.
test_results.T5_equipment_scan_per_run: PASS — /equipment-scan/<E_RUN>: 'Cleared — ready for next production run' button opens param-capture-dialog; entering Pressure=5 → Save → per-run card shows 'Cleared for the next run by System Admin · 2026-09-13 11:13'.

critical_code_review_comments: MaintenanceScan.js line 367: readings header says '(required to complete)' when status==='completed' but also '(optional)' otherwise. The server rejects a completed submission with missing required values (verified in T2), so the wording is accurate. Consider also showing the '*' asterisk on required inputs even when status is not yet chosen so operators know upfront which are required.
ParamInputs (MaintenanceParams.js line 21): when both min AND max are null the hint renders as '– – –' which reads oddly. Consider hiding the limits row entirely when there is no min/max defined.

ParamCaptureDialog uses local `values` state initialised to {} — closing and reopening resets values, which is correct; but it means the parent flow cannot preserve partially-entered values on toast errors. Acceptable for the small dialog but worth noting.
The 'required' asterisk in ParamInputs uses `p.required !== false` (default true). This matches the equipment form default and is consistent.
